info.title: PANNs log-mel
info.author: EleTect X
info.description: Log-mel spectrogram using the exact front-end convention the PANNs AudioSet backbones were trained with: 32 kHz, 1024-point Hann STFT, 320-sample hop, 64 Slaney-normalised mel filters over 50-14000 Hz, power spectrum, and 10*log10 with no noise-floor clipping and no top_db ceiling. The stock MFE block zeroes every bin below a noise floor, which is not this convention - feeding MFE output to a PANNs backbone shifts the input distribution away from the one the pretrained weights expect.
info.name: PANNs log-mel

items.name: Number of mel filters
items.help: PANNs checkpoints are trained at 64. Changing this invalidates the pretrained weights.

items.name: FFT length
items.help: PANNs window_size. 1024 at 32 kHz is a 32 ms analysis window.

items.name: Hop length
items.help: PANNs hop_size. 320 at 32 kHz is 10 ms per frame.

items.name: Low frequency
items.help: fmin. Below this is wind and handling noise at the deployment site.

items.name: High frequency
items.help: fmax. PANNs uses 14 kHz, just under the 16 kHz Nyquist of its 32 kHz rate.

items.name: Centre on loudest 100 ms
items.help: Reproduces the training harness's --crop peak, used for the 3 s configuration. Leave off for deployment: Edge Impulse already slides the window over the stream, so a transient cannot fall outside it, and re-centring here would make the deployed features differ from the ones the impulse was tested on.
